purpose: Evaluate paper-set discovery and synthesis routing against paper reading, database lookup, citation verification, and downstream evidence planning.

cases.query: 为单细胞 ATAC-seq 批次校正做系统文献检索，记录检索式、纳排标准和证据表。
cases.rationale: Reproducible discovery and screening of a paper set are core intents.

cases.query: 项目启动前比较三类蛋白语言模型方法，整理共识、争议、数据集和可复现代码。
cases.rationale: Method landscape synthesis across papers belongs here.

cases.query: 帮我找到支持 enhancer hijacking 机制的 primary studies，并区分 review 和直接证据。
cases.rationale: Targeted discovery plus evidence-type screening is a literature workflow.

cases.query: 设计 PubMed 和 bioRxiv 检索，寻找 repeat-rich locus 可用的长读长公共数据集。
cases.rationale: Literature-led public dataset discovery is explicitly supported.

cases.query: 检索 GeneA 与 GeneB 是否有直接互作、结构域依据和 docking feasibility 文献。
cases.rationale: Layered interaction and docking-feasibility literature search is a routed variant.

cases.query: 只制定关于空间转录组去卷积的可复现 search strategy，不实际声称找到任何论文。
cases.rationale: A planned search strategy is a valid mode when labeled planned.

cases.query: 对 2019–2026 年肿瘤克隆进化 benchmark 做 title/abstract screening 和 full-text inclusion log。
cases.rationale: Two-stage screening with a date window is a core workflow.

cases.query: 从已有 12 篇 seed papers 做 backward/forward citation chaining，找遗漏的方法论文。
cases.rationale: Citation chaining to expand a paper set belongs here.

cases.query: 把 CRISPR off-target prediction 文献整理成 dataset-method-gap evidence map 和下一步复现清单。
cases.rationale: Decision-oriented evidence-map synthesis is a core deliverable.

cases.query: 没有检索到直接证据时，报告检索范围、空结果和最接近的间接证据，不要把未检出写成不存在。
cases.rationale: Bounded negative-search reporting is part of reproducible retrieval.

cases.query: 请逐图精读我上传的这篇 Nature PDF。
cases.rationale: A specified paper with figure reading belongs to paper-reader.

cases.query: 核对 rs123 在 ClinVar 和 gnomAD 的 build、REF/ALT 与 allele frequency。
cases.rationale: Entity-level database record reconciliation is not literature discovery.

cases.query: 检查这 40 条 DOI 是否真实，作者年份是否正确，并判断是否支持相邻句子。
cases.rationale: Auditing an existing citation set belongs to citation-verifier.

cases.query: 根据现有 Figure 1–4 找出投稿前必须补的最小分析。
cases.rationale: Prioritizing gaps in an existing evidence package belongs elsewhere.

cases.query: 检查 Results 是否把相关性写成因果，并给出降级措辞。
cases.rationale: Claim-strength auditing without literature discovery belongs to claim-evidence-audit.

cases.query: 把我给的三篇固定论文按相同字段做精读比较，不要找新文献。
cases.rationale: A closed, specified paper set is a paper-reading task.

cases.query: 用 Ensembl API 查这个区间的 gene 和 regulatory features。
cases.rationale: A direct database query belongs to database grounding.

cases.query: 把参考文献从 Vancouver 改成 APA，真实性不用检查。
cases.rationale: Pure citation styling is outside this research-search skill.

cases.query: 下载公开 FASTQ，完成比对、定量和差异表达。
cases.rationale: Data acquisition and analysis execution are not literature synthesis.

cases.query: 润色 Introduction，让语言更像期刊文章，不增加引用。
cases.rationale: Language polishing without retrieval is not a literature workflow.
